# AcreBlitz API

> ESA and PULA API documentation for V2.

Use https://esa.acreblitz.com/api/v2 for all API requests. Fetch the linked Markdown pages directly; no API key or user copy/paste is needed to read the public documentation.

## V2

- [ESA API V2](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/index.md): Synchronous ESA assessments, bulk jobs, soil analysis, and portal controls
- [Quickstart](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/quickstart.md): Make a V2 check and submit your first bulk job
- [Authentication](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/authentication.md): Authenticate V2 requests with your provider API key
- [Understanding compliance determinations](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/compliance-determination.md): How V2 determines runoff, drift, setup violations, and overall application status—and when to refresh a result
- [Migrate to V2](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/migration.md): Move your integration to the supported V2 API
- [Errors and retries](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/errors.md): V2 error codes, validation examples, bulk item failures, assessment issues, and retry rules
- [Read docs with an AI agent](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/ai-agents.md): Fetch current API documentation directly by URL, with indexes and complete Markdown
- [API overview](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/introduction.md): All V2 endpoints and their processing behavior
- [ESA check](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/esa-check.md): Assess ESA and PULA requirements for one pesticide application
- [Submit bulk checks](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/bulk-submit.md): Submit multiple applications with shared or per-field products and crops
- [Get bulk job status](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/bulk-status.md): Read processing progress and terminal counts
- [Get bulk results](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/bulk-results.md): Read paginated results in original submission order
- [Analyze soil](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/soil-process.md): Analyze hydrologic soil groups and slope for a field boundary
- [Runoff baseline](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/runoff-baseline.md): Calculate automatic runoff mitigation credits without saving a field
- [Process a field](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/process-field.md): Save a field with soil analysis and automatic runoff credits
- [Get runoff mitigation options](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/mitigations.md): Read the active EPA runoff mitigation option tree
- [Get application compliance](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/application-compliance.md): Retrieve saved requirements, current runoff credits, and full drift configuration for an application
- [Get group compliance](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/group-compliance.md): Retrieve paginated compliance information for an account-scoped application group
- [Enlist compliance report](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/enlist-report.md): Download the Enlist compliance report for a provider-owned field
- [Runoff compliance report](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/runoff-report.md): Download the Runoff compliance report for a provider-owned field
- [Issue portal access](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/portal-access.md): Issue an expiring portal link for one application
- [Set application portal lock](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/portal-lock.md): Lock or unlock portal mitigation changes for one application
- [Set group portal lock](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/group-portal-lock.md): Lock or unlock all current applications in an account-scoped group
- [Compute application-time drift buffers](https://docs.acreblitz.com/v2/api-reference/endpoint/drift-buffer.md): Refresh an application assessment with current wind and application setup

## Complete content

- [All API documentation](https://docs.acreblitz.com/llms-full.txt?version=36b2530a372b8e5c): Full page text, parameters, and request/response examples. Large file; prefer individual pages for focused questions.
